plan.title: Award Two-Bid RFQ to L1 and Approve

steps.note: Open the prepared closed RFQ directly on Master QCS.
Assert the prepared comparison grid has the single vendor available in this state; the missing second bid is recorded as an expressiveness gap.
Allocate the available line to the available vendor as the closest supported version of awarding all requested units to one vendor.
Verify the available line and vendor are selected on the awarding screen.
Create the award proposal from the completed allocation.
Assert that the proposal page opened.

args.goal: fill the required proposal fields and submit the award proposal; stop when the proposal page shows the submitted or approval state

steps.note: Complete the proposal fields and submission that have no dedicated catalog step.
Assert the proposal exposes the approval state after submission.

args.need: sign in as the separate approver, open this proposal from Approvals, enter the remark "OK — QA", and approve it

steps.note: The separate approver session and approval action cannot be performed by the catalog.
